title: Grade 4 Math — Mon, Jun 01
description: Fractions — Day 1 of 5: What is a fraction?
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A cake is cut into 4 equal parts. One part is what fraction?
questions.explanation: One of four equal parts is 1/4.

questions.question: In the fraction 3/5, the number 5 is the ___.
questions.explanation: The bottom number (total equal parts) is the denominator.

questions.question: In 3/5, the number 3 is the ___.
questions.explanation: The top number (parts taken) is the numerator.

questions.question: If 2 of 6 equal slices are eaten, what fraction is eaten?
questions.explanation: 2 parts out of 6 equal parts is 2/6.

questions.question: Which fraction means 'one half'?
questions.explanation: One of two equal parts is 1/2 — one half.

questions.question: A pizza in 8 equal slices; 3 are taken. Fraction taken?
The fraction 4/4 is equal to ___.
questions.explanation: All 4 of 4 parts make one whole, so 4/4 = 1.

questions.question: Which picture shows 1/3 shaded? (3 equal parts, ___ shaded)
questions.explanation: 1/3 means 1 of 3 equal parts is shaded.

questions.question: A chocolate bar of 10 squares; 7 are left. Fraction left?
For a fraction, the parts must be ___.
questions.explanation: Fractions only work when the whole is split into equal parts.

questions.question: What fraction is half of a whole?
If 5 of 5 equal parts are coloured, the fraction is ___.
Which fraction is the smallest piece?
questions.explanation: More equal parts means smaller pieces; 1/8 is the smallest here.

questions.question: A glass is 1/4 full. How many more quarters to fill it?
6 of 9 equal parts are shaded. The fraction shaded is ___.
